title: Changing a hotel booking
instructions: Bayan Lee telefonda otel rezervasyonunu değiştiriyor. Uzun bir diyalog; eski ve yeni bilgileri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: lee
script.text: Hello. I have a booking for next week, but I want to change it. My name is Anna Lee.

script.speaker: rec
script.text: Let me see. A single room for two nights, from Monday the fifth?

script.speaker: lee
script.text: Yes. Now my husband is coming too. Can I have a double room?

script.speaker: rec
script.text: Of course. And the same dates?

script.speaker: lee
script.text: No. We want to arrive on Tuesday the sixth, and stay for three nights.

script.speaker: rec
script.text: OK. A double room from Tuesday the sixth to Friday the ninth.

script.speaker: rec
script.text: It's eighty pounds a night, with breakfast.

script.speaker: rec
script.text: Yes, it's free for hotel guests.

questions.prompt: What room did Mrs Lee book first?
questions.evidence: A single room for two nights

questions.prompt: Why does she want to change the room?
questions.feedback: Eşi de geliyor; çift kişilik oda istiyor.
